title: The One Ring
gametext:
Response: If the Ring-bearer is about to take a wound, he or she wears The One Ring until the regroup phase.
While the Ring-bearer is wearing The One Ring, each time he or she is about to take a wound, add a burden instead.
lore: '...ash nazg thrakatulûk agh burzum-ishi krimpatul.'
subtitle: The Ring of Rings

title: The One Ring
gametext:
Response: If the Ring-bearer is about to take a wound in a skirmish, he or she wears The One Ring until the regroup phase.
While the Ring-bearer is wearing The One Ring, each time he or she is about to take a wound in a skirmish, add a burden instead.
lore: One Ring to rule them all....
subtitle: The Ruling Ring

title: Axe of Khazad-dûm
gametext:
Bearer must be a Dwarf.
While bearer is at a mountain site, he is damage +1.
lore: The Dwarves led by Balin to the great Dwarf-hall of old, though ill-prepared, were well-armed.

title: Battle to the Last
gametext: Spot a Dwarf. For each wound on that Dwarf, make him strength +2 and damage +1.
lore: As had the children of Durin and the followers of Balin before him, Gimli would fight the interlopers in Khazad-dûm with all his strength.

title: Dwarven Embassy
gametext:
To play, spot a Dwarf.
Each companion is damage +1.
Discard this condition at the end of your turn.
lore: Glóin and his countrymen stood as reassurance that the Dwarves would also stand against the will of the Dark Lord.

title: Fallen Lord
gametext: Exert the Ring-bearer and a Dwarf to make that Dwarf strength +X, where X equals that Dwarf's resistance.
lore: He is dead then,' said Frodo. 'I feared it was so.' Gimli cast his hood over his face.

title: Farin
gametext: While Farin is at a battleground or underground site, he gains muster. (At the start of the regroup phase, you may discard a card from hand to draw a card.)
lore: 'If we make no answer, the Enemy may move Men of his rule to assail King Brand, and Dáin also.'
subtitle: Emissary of Erebor

title: Gimli
gametext:
Damage +1.
Each time Gimli wins a skirmish, you may draw a card.
lore: '...I am content. Till now I have hewn naught but wood since I left Moria.'
subtitle: Lively Combatant

title: Gimli's Battle Axe
gametext:
Bearer must be a Dwarf.
Bearer gains muster. (At the start of the regroup phase, you may discard a card from hand to draw a card.)
Skirmish: If bearer is Gimli and he is at a battleground site, exert him to wound a minion he is skirmishing.
subtitle: Vicious Weapon

title: Grimir
gametext: Response: If a [dwarven] companion is about to take a wound in a skirmish, discard 2 [dwarven] cards from play (except characters) to prevent that.
lore: '...we crave the advice of Elrond. For the Shadow grows and draws nearer.'
subtitle: Dwarven Emissary

title: Hall of Our Fathers
gametext:
When you play this condition, stack the top 8 cards of your draw deck here.
At the start of your maneuver phase, you may spot a Dwarf to exchange the cards stacked here with your hand.
lore: '...at last we had the power and numbers to return.'

title: Mountain Homestead
gametext:
To play, spot 2 Dwarf companions.
While the fellowship is at a mountain site, each Dwarf is strength +2.
lore: The Dwarves are as hard and stalwart as the lands in which they've made their homes.

title: On Guard
gametext: If a Dwarf who has resistance 3 or more is about to take a wound, prevent that.
lore: 'Well, here's one Dwarf she won't ensnare so easily.'

title: Well-equipped
gametext: Discard a [dwarven] card from hand to play a [dwarven] possession from your draw deck on a [dwarven] companion who has resistance 5 or more.
lore: Stout and unmindful of the most ample load, Dwarven warriors laden themselves with heavy armor and myriad weaponry.

title: Arwen
gametext: Each minion skirmishing Arwen is strength -1 for each forest site on the adventure path.
lore: 'What grace is given me, let it pass to him. Let him be spared. Save him.'
subtitle: Staunch Defender

title: Blade of Lindon
gametext:
Bearer must be an Elf.
While bearer is at a forest or river site, each minion he or she is skirmishing is strength -1.
lore: To this day, many Elven weapons are forged in the fashion of those wielded by Gil-galad's forces.

title: Elven Marksmanship
gametext:
To play, spot an Elf.
Toil 2. (For each [elven] character you exert when playing this, its twilight cost is -2.)
Archery: Discard this condition to make the fellowship archery total +2.
lore: Sighted by keen vision and loosed with blinding swiftness, Elven arrows rarely miss their targets.

title: Elven Scout
gametext: While you can spot another Elf, this companion has muster. (At the start of the regroup phase, you may discard a card from hand to draw a card.)
lore: None who draw within a league of the Celebrant escape unnoticed the patrols from Caras Galadhon.

title: Farewell to Lórien
gametext: Spot an Elf to heal each companion who has resistance 5 or more.
lore: '...the memory of Lothlórien shall remain ever clear and unstained in your heart, and shall neither fade nor grow stale.'

title: The Lady's Blessing
gametext: Make an Elf strength +2 (or +3 at a river site).
lore: 'We have come to bid our last farewell,' she said, 'and to speed you with blessings from our land.'

title: Legolas
gametext: While Legolas is at a battleground or forest site, he is strength +2 and resistance +2.
lore: 'I am one of the Nine Companions who set out with Mithrandir from Imladris... and with this Dwarf, my friend, I came with the Lord Aragorn.'
subtitle: Companion of the Ring

title: Legolas
gametext: At the start of the archery phase, you may spot another Elf to exert a minion.
lore: Travelling to the council at Imladris was only the beginning of a much greater journey for the Elven Prince. 'Few can foresee whither their road will lead 'them, till they come to its end.'"
subtitle: Woodland Emissary

title: Legolas' Bow
gametext:
Bearer must be an Elf.
Bearer is an archer.
If bearer is Legolas, each time you exert him to play an [elven] condition or [elven] event, you may heal him (limit once per phase).
lore: Though not as sturdy as the bows of the Galadhrim, a Mirkwood bow is no less dangerous in skilled hands.

title: Might of the Elf-lords
gametext: Exert an Elf to reveal the top card of your draw deck. If that card's twilight cost is 3 or less, make a minion strength -3.
lore: Dimly Frodo saw the river below him rise, and down along its course there came a plumed cavalry of waves.

title: Nocked
gametext: Exert an Elf who has resistance 4 or more to wound a minion.
lore: Legolas can fit an arrow to his bowstring faster than most can clear a blade from its scabbard.

title: Uncertain Future
gametext:
When you play this condition, spot an Elf to add 3 [elven] tokens here.
Maneuver: Discard this condition or remove an [elven] token from here to reveal the top card of your draw deck. You may place that card beneath your draw deck.
lore: 'What did you see?'

effect.text: Would you like to place {revealedCard} beneath your draw deck?

title: Woodland Sentinel
gametext: While this companion is at a forest site, he is strength +2.
lore: 'We drove them off after some time; they were many and fierce, but they came from over the mountains, and were unused to the woods.'

title: The Art of Gandalf
gametext:
To play, spot a [gandalf] Wizard.
Regroup: Stack a spell from hand here.
Fellowship: Discard a [gandalf] card from hand to take a card stacked here into hand.
lore: The fireworks were by Gandalf: they were not only brought by him, but designed and made by him....

title: Ease the Burden
gametext: Exert a [gandalf] Wizard to remove a burden (or 2 burdens if the fellowship is at a dwelling site).
lore: 'Bilbo was meant to find the Ring. In which case, you also were meant to have it. And that is an encouraging thought.'

title: Erland
gametext:
To play, spot a [gandalf] companion.
Skirmish: Exert Erland to take a [gandalf] skirmish event from your discard pile into hand.
lore: 'They are valiant men and keep open the High Pass and the Ford of Carrock.'
subtitle: Dale Counselor

title: Final Account
gametext:
To play, exert a [gandalf] Wizard.
Discard 2 cards from hand to take a Free Peoples card and a Shadow card from your discard pile into hand.
lore: Gandalf lifted it carefully, but the leaves crackled and broke as he laid it on the slab.

title: G for Grand
gametext: While you can spot a [gandalf] Wizard, each companion who has resistance 6 or more is strength +1.
lore: To them he was just one of the 'attractions' at the party. Hence the excitement of the hobbit-children.

title: Gandalf
gametext:
While Gandalf is in region 1, each other companion is strength +2.
While Gandalf is in region 2, each companion is strength +1.
While Gandalf is in region 3, he is strength +2.
lore: 'I will help you bear this burden, Frodo Baggins....'
subtitle: Leader of the Company

title: Gandalf's Staff
gametext:
Bearer must be a Wizard.
If bearer is Gandalf, he gains muster. (At the start of the regroup phase, you may discard a card from hand to draw a card.)
Each time bearer wins a skirmish, choose a Shadow player who must wound a minion.
subtitle: Ash-staff

title: Glamdring
gametext:
Bearer must be Gandalf.
Each time Gandalf wins a skirmish, you may remove a burden.
lore: There was a ringing clash and a stab of white fire.
subtitle: Foe-hammer

title: Inspiration
gametext: Spot a [gandalf] Wizard to reveal your hand and make a minion strength -3 for each companion in your hand (or -4 for each if the fellowship is at a battleground site).
lore: Through his own strength, Gandalf spurred all the Free Peoples of Middle-earth to stand against the coming darkness.

title: New Authority
gametext:
To play, spot a [gandalf] Wizard.
Each time a Shadow card adds a burden, you may remove (3).
Response: If a minion uses its special ability, discard this condition to cancel the effect of that special ability.
lore: 'Prepare for battle!'

title: New-awakened
gametext:
Spell. Toil 2. (For each [gandalf] character you exert when playing this, its twilight cost is -2.)
Spot a [gandalf] Wizard to discard 2 conditions from play.
lore: 'Too long have you sat in shadows and trusted to twisted tales and crooked promptings.'

title: Prolonged Struggle
gametext: Exert a [gandalf] Wizard and spot 2 companions who each have resistance 7 or more to wound a minion that Wizard is skirmishing twice.
lore: 'We fought far under the living earth, where time is not counted.'

title: Shadowfax
gametext:
Bearer must be Gandalf.
Each time Gandalf is about to take a wound, you may add a burden to prevent that.
lore: 'He has come for me: the horse of the White Rider. We are going to battle together.'
subtitle: Unequaled Steed

title: Frenzied Attack
gametext: If a minion is skirmishing a Free Peoples character who has resistance 2 or less, spot Gollum to wound that character twice.
lore: 'He musstn't hurt Preciouss. Give it to Sméagol, yess, give it to us! Give it to uss!'

title: Gollum
gametext:
Lurker. (Skirmishes involving lurker minions must be resolved after any others.)
Skirmish: Exert Gollum twice to make another minion strength +2.
lore: 'O yes, Shelob will get him, not Sméagol: he promised; he won't hurt Master at all.'
subtitle: Skulker

title: Horribly Strong
gametext: Discard Gollum from play to wound an unbound companion who has resistance 6 or less.
lore: Gollum hissed and spat, but he did not let go.

title: Incited
gametext: Each time a companion loses a skirmish, you may exert Gollum to take a [gollum] card into hand from your discard pile.
lore: 'He's much more dangerous than he looks.'

title: Led Astray
gametext: Spot Gollum to add (3) and exchange one of your sites on the adventure path with another site from your adventure deck.
lore: So far Gollum's plot had succeeded.

title: Master Commands It
gametext: Make Sméagol strength +1 for each companion who has resistance 5 or more.
lore: 'It's not sense to try and get into Mordor at all. But if master says I must go or I will go, then he must try some way.'

title: No End of Wickedness
gametext: Exert Gollum to make another minion strength +2 (or +3 if Gollum is at a mountain site).
lore: ...a fear was growing on him, a menace which he could not see....

title: Not Yet Vanquished
gametext: Each time a companion loses a fierce skirmish, you may exert Gollum to add a burden.
lore: A sudden weight smote him and he crashed forward, tearing the backs of his hands that still clasped his master's.

title: One Good Turn Deserves Another
gametext: Spot Sméagol to play the fellowship's next site. Then you may add a burden to take this card back into hand.
lore: 'Nice hobbits! We will come with them. Find them safe paths in the dark, yes we will.'

effect.text: Do you want to add a burden to return {self} to hand?

title: Safe Passage
gametext:
When you play this condition, name forest, mountain, plains, or river.
Each time the fellowship moves to a site that has the named keyword, you may exert Gollum or Sméagol to remove (4).
lore: 'Here! We can get down here. Sméagol went this way once: I went this way, hiding from Orcs.'

title: Sméagol
gametext:
Ring-bound. To play, add a burden.
Each time Sméagol wins a skirmish, you may play the fellowship's next site.
Skirmish: If Sméagol is at a marsh, exert him to cancel a skirmish involving him.
lore: They would have foundered in the Dead Marshes but for Gollum.
subtitle: Scout and Guide

title: Strange and Terrible
gametext: Spot a [gollum] minion at a mountain site to play a minion from your discard pile.
lore: Gollum on the edge of the abyss was fighting like a mad thing with an unseen foe.

title: Aragorn
gametext:
Ranger.
Each time a Free Peoples skirmish event is played, you may exert Aragorn to wound a minion he is skirmishing.
lore: '...I know all the lands between the Shire and the Misty Mountains, for I have wandered over them for many years.'
subtitle: Guide and Protector

title: Aragorn
gametext:
Ranger.
Each time the fellowship moves, add (1).
lore: ...in spite of the heat of the room he wore a hood that overshadowed his face; but the gleam of his eyes could be seen as he watched the hobbits.
subtitle: Strider

title: Armor of the Citadel
gametext:
Bearer must be a [gondor] Man.
Each minion skirmishing bearer loses all damage bonuses.
While bearer is at a battleground site and unwounded, he or she is defender +1.
lore: Upon the black surcoats were embroidered in white a tree blossoming like snow....

title: Battle Cry
gametext: Make a ranger strength +2 (or +3 if he or she is skirmishing a minion who has a damage bonus).
lore: '...men were yelling and screaming, and one clear loud voice was calling 'Gondor! Gondor!'

title: Boromir
gametext:
Knight.
Each time Boromir wins a skirmish, you may heal a [gondor] companion.
lore: 'Let the armies of Mordor know this: never again will the land of my people fall into enemy hands!'
subtitle: Hero of Osgiliath

title: Bow of Minas Tirith
gametext:
Bearer must be a [gondor] Man.
At the start of the archery phase, if bearer is at a battleground site, you may exert him or her to make the fellowship archery total +1.
lore: From the ramparts of the Gondorian fortress, death rained down upon the servants of Sauron.

title: Gondorian Blade
gametext:
Bearer must be a [gondor] Man.
While bearer is a ranger or at a river site, he or she is damage +1.
lore: While many knights of Gondor favor hand-and-a-half swords, lighter weapons are often preferred by the rangers who patrol Ithilien.

title: The Highest Quality
gametext: Exert any number of [gondor] companions who have total resistance 12 or more to make a minion skirmishing a [gondor] companion strength -3 for each companion exerted this way.
lore: 'Captain Faramir, you have shown your quality, sir. The very highest.'

effect.text: Choose companions to exert with total resistance 12 or more

title: Houses of Healing
gametext:
When you play this condition, spot a [gondor] Man to add 3 [gondor] tokens here.
Fellowship: Add (2) and either discard this condition or remove a [gondor] token from here to heal a [gondor] Man.
lore: ...the king was indeed come among them, and after war he brought healing....

title: Madril
gametext:
Ranger.
Fellowship: If Madril is at a forest site, exert him to play the fellowship's next site.
lore: '...we must look to our own borders. Faramir, Orcs are on the move.'
subtitle: Ranger of Ithilien

title: Much-needed Rest
gametext: Heal each [gondor] companion who has resistance 5 or more.
lore: 'A guest-house shall be made ready: there you shall sleep, when you have eaten.'

title: Pledge of Loyalty
gametext: Make a [gondor] companion strength +2 (or +3 if he or she has resistance 4 or more).
lore: 'I ask leave once again to be your companion, Frodo.'

title: Ranger of Westernesse
gametext:
Ranger.
When you play this companion, you may play the fellowship's next site.
lore: The road may pass, but they shall not!

title: Well-traveled
gametext:
To play, exert a ranger.
If the fellowship is in region 1, play the fellowship's next 2 sites.
Otherwise, play the fellowship's next site.
lore: With a great many years' experience in the wilds of Middle-earth, Aragorn's skills as guide and tracker were unmatched.

title: Archer of Harad
gametext:
Archer.
While you can spot a companion who has resistance 4 or less, the minion archery total is +1.
lore: Haradrim bowmen pick off stragglers who rout after losing a battle.

title: Armored Easterling
gametext:
Skirmish: Remove (2) to make a lurker strength +1.
Skirmish: Remove (2) to make a lurker fierce until the regroup phase.
Skirmish: Remove (2) to make a lurker damage +1.
lore: The Men of the East were well-equipped.

title: Axeman of Harad
gametext: While you can spot a companion who has resistance 3 or less, this minion's twilight cost is -2.
lore: Tribes of Harad gather when their enemies appear weak.

title: Bloodthirsty
gametext: Spot 2 [men] minions to wound an unbound companion.
lore: The ferocity of the Dunlendings is not easily slaked.

title: Bold and Cunning
gametext:
Toil 2. (For each [men] character you exert when playing this, its twilight cost is -2.)
Spot a [men] minion to discard a possession from play.
lore: 'Even now he plays a game with peril and wins a throw.'

title: Column of Easterlings
gametext:
Lurker. (Skirmishes involving lurker minions must be resolved after any others.)
Skirmish: Discard this minion to make a [men] minion strength +4.
lore: The military training of the Easterlings is evident in their marching formations.

title: Corps of Harad
gametext: While this minion is at a battleground site, it is fierce.
lore: When an enemy offers resistance, the Haradrim bloodlust rises to the occasion.

title: Detachment of Haradrim
gametext: Maneuver: Exert this minion to add (1) for each companion who has resistance 5 or less.
lore: No mere soldiers, all the Men of Harad are skilled assassins and raiders.

title: Easterling Host
gametext:
Lurker. (Skirmishes involving lurker minions must be resolved after any others.)
Skirmish: Exert Easterling Host and make it strength -2 until the regroup phase to make each other [men] minion strength +1 until the regroup phase.
lore: Men of the East mass soldiers into huge groups.

title: Easterling Shield Wall
gametext:
Lurker. (Skirmishes involving lurker minions must be resolved after any others.)
Response: If a [men] minion is about to take a wound in a skirmish, exert this minion and remove (1) to prevent that.
lore: Tight columns allow Easterlings to protect each other.

title: Elder of Dunland
gametext: While this minion is at a plains site, it is damage +1.
lore: Experienced warriors gather the disparate tribes for massive raids.

title: Elevated Fire
gametext:
Toil 2. (For each [men] character you exert when playing this, its twilight cost is -2.)
Spot a [men] minion to make the minion archery total +3.
lore: The war towers of the mûmakil provide a great advantage for archers.

title: Fearsome Dunlending
gametext:
Ambush (1).
When you play this minion at a plains site, you may spot an unbound companion to make that companion resistance -1 until the end of the turn.
lore: Accustomed as they are to traveling afoot, Dunlending mobs can strike quickly, without warning.

title: Ferocious Haradrim
gametext:
Archer.
Each time a Free Peoples character is killed, each of your [men] minions is strength +3 until the regroup phase.
lore: The killing frenzy of the Southrons is in stark contrast to the cool efficiency of Easterling columns.

title: Fletcher of Harad
gametext:
While this minion is at a plains site, it is an archer.
While you can spot 6 companions, each [men] minion is an archer.
lore: Makers of bows and arrows have a strong trade for the raiders of Harad.

title: Footman of Dunland
gametext: The fellowship's current site gains plains.
lore: Their savage war bands move swiftly across flat terrain.

title: Force of Harad
gametext: When you cannot spot another [men] minion, discard this minion.
lore: Alliances between Haradrim tribes are fragile things which sometimes break down in battle.

title: Harad Standard-bearer
gametext: Skirmish: Remove (3) to make this minion damage +1.
lore: The strange craftsmen of Haradwaith fashion their war banners from woven wood.

title: Horde of Harad
gametext: While this minion is at a battleground site, it is fierce.
lore: Raiders and brigands they may be, but in force the Southron fighters are terrifying.

title: Invading Haradrim
gametext: Each time the Free Peoples player assigns this minion to a skirmish, add (1) for each Free Peoples character who has resistance 5 or less.
lore: The cruel Men of Harad slaughter the weak and infirm during their raids on Gondor.

title: Láthspell
gametext:
To play, spot a [men] minion.
Bearer must be a companion.
While bearer is skirmishing a [men] minion, bearer loses all strength and damage bonuses from possessions.
lore: '...ill news is an ill guest they say.'

title: Legion of Harad
gametext: Toil 2. (For each [men] character you exert when playing this, its twilight cost is -2.)
lore: The bellicose families of Harad cannot often agree, but when they do, they form a formidable army.

title: Long Battle Bow
gametext:
Bearer must be a [men] minion.
Bearer is an archer.
When you play this possession, you may make the Free Peoples player exert his or her Man.
lore: Southron accuracy with bows is legendary.

title: Man of Bree
gametext: This minion is strength +1 for each card in the Free Peoples player's hand.
lore: One or two gave Frodo a blank look and departed muttering among themselves.

title: Oath Sworn
gametext: At the start of the maneuver phase, if you have 2 or more cards in hand, you may spot 2 [men] minions and discard your hand to add (8).
lore: 'We will fight for you!'

title: Overrun
gametext: Make a [men] minion strength +2 (or +4 if that minion is at a battleground or plains site).
lore: An Easterling column strikes with terrific force.

title: Patroller of Haradrim
gametext: Each time this minion is assigned to a character who has resistance 5 or less, you may discard a possession borne by that character.
lore: Disarming strikes are common among the tactics of the Men of Harad.

title: Pavise
gametext:
Bearer must be a [men] minion.
The twilight cost of this possession is -1 for each Free Peoples possession you spot.
Bearer cannot take wounds except during a skirmish.
lore: An Easterling shield covers almost the entire body.

title: Poleaxe
gametext:
Bearer must be a [men] minion.
Skirmish: Remove (2) to make a [men] minion fierce until the regroup phase.
lore: Many of the Men of the East march into battle carrying heavy bladed polearms.

title: Precision Targeting
gametext: Spot a [men] minion to make the minion archery total +1 and to make the Free Peoples player choose 3 companions. Other companions cannot take archery wounds.
lore: Arrows fired in volleys will never be as effective as one loosed by a skilled archer.

effect.text: Choose companions who can take archery total

title: Raging Dunlending
gametext:
When you play this minion, you may exert it to make it fierce until the regroup phase.
While you can spot 6 companions, each [men] minion is fierce.
lore: Furious hatred over the land they've lost drives the mobs of Dunland.

title: Rampaging Easterling
gametext:
Lurker. (Skirmishes involving lurker minions must be resolved after any others.)
Each time another [men] minion wins a skirmish, make this minion strength +3 until the regroup phase.
lore: The fury of the Eastern warriors grows in battle.

title: Squad of Haradrim
gametext: Regroup: Spot another [men] minion and 2 Free Peoples characters who each have resistance 5 or less to make the move limit -1 for this turn.
lore: Small, harassing bands of Haradrim skirmishers make moving troops difficult.

title: Strange-looking Men
gametext: Maneuver: Exert this minion to transfer a possession or condition borne by a character to another eligible bearer.
lore: The strangers, especially those that had come up the Greenway, stared at them curiously.

title: Swarthy Bree-lander
gametext: At the start of the maneuver phase, you may remove (2) to transfer a condition borne by a character to another eligible bearer.
lore: But there was one... who stood looking at them with a knowing and half-mocking expression that made them feel very uncomfortable.

title: Throng of Harad
gametext: Each time this minion is assigned to skirmish a character who has resistance 5 or less, it is fierce until the regroup phase.
lore: Only the strongest fighters can withstand a Southron attack.

title: Warrior of Dunland
gametext:
Ambush (1).
While this minion is at a plains site, it gains an additional ambush (1).
lore: The open plain affords no shelter, no defense against the Dunlendings.

title: Whistling Death
gametext: Wound a character skirmishing a [men] minion. If the fellowship is at a battleground site, you may remove (3) to wound that character again.
lore: As deadly as the Southron arrows, their polearms cut a whirling swath through their enemies.

true.text: Would you like to remove (3) to wound {woundedCharacter} again?

title: Wielding the Ring
gametext:
To play, spot a [men] minion.
Bearer must be a companion (except the Ring-bearer).
lore: 'Why should we not think that the Great Ring has come into our hands to serve us in the very hour of need?'

title: Armed for Battle
gametext: Spot your [orc] minion to play an [orc] possession from your discard pile (or, if that minion is at a battleground site, from your draw deck or discard pile).
lore: Fashioned by the hands of Orcs, or plundered from the hands of defeated enemies, the weaponry of Mordor is bounteous.

title: Barbarous Orc
gametext: Skirmish: Exert another [orc] minion to make this minion strength +2 (or +4 if this minion is skirmishing a companion who has resistance 4 or less).
lore: Fiercely tribal, rival Orc bands unite only against a more hated enemy.

title: Beastly Olog-hai
gametext:
Damage +1. Fierce. To play, spot an [orc] minion.
Assignment: Exert this minion to assign it to a companion bearing an artifact. The Free Peoples player may discard an artifact from play to prevent this.
lore: Some held that they were not Trolls, but giant Orcs....

effect.preventText: Would you like to discard an artifact to prevent the assignment of {chosenCompanion} to {self}?

title: Bladed Gauntlets
gametext:
Bearer must be an [orc] minion.
Bearer is a lurker. (Skirmishes involving lurker minions must be resolved after any others.)
Skirmish: Exert bearer to make an [orc] minion strength +2.
lore: One cannot easily discern Orc armor from weapon.

title: Bound to its Fate
gametext: Spot an [orc] minion to reveal the Free Peoples player's hand. The Free Peoples player chooses to either discard a revealed Free Peoples event or add a burden.
lore: 'Now it comes to it, I don't like parting with it at all, I may say.'

title: Champion Orc
gametext: Toil 2. (For each [orc] character you exert when playing this, its twilight cost is -2.)
lore: A few Orcs are veterans of single combats to settle disputes in the mountain tribes.

title: Conquered Halls
gametext: Make an [orc] minion strength +1 for each underground site you can spot.
lore: They brandished spears and scimitars which shone red as blood in the firelight.

title: Cutthroat Orc
gametext: This minion is strength +1 for each companion who has resistance 5 or less.
lore: The smell of human flesh is often enough to frenzy an Orc warrior.

title: Demoralized
gametext:
To play, spot an [orc] minion.
Each time a companion exerts, you may add (1) (or (2) if you can spot 6 companions).
lore: But soon there were few left in Minas Tirith who had the heart to stand up and defy the hosts of Mordor.

title: Denizen of Khazad-dûm
gametext: While this minion is at an underground site, it is strength +2.
lore: The spiny helms forged by the Orcs of Moria can inflict as much damage as their scimitars.

title: Denizen of Moria
gametext: While this minion is at an underground site, it is strength +3.
lore: The vast tunnels of Khazad-dûm are the veins through which a foul Orc ichor can flow unchecked.

title: Denizen of the Black Pit
gametext: While this minion is at an underground site, it is strength +2.
lore: The great Dwarf mansion of Khazad-dûm is now more commonly known by other, darker names.

title: Dread and Despair
gametext: Spot 2 [orc] minions to discard a condition from play. The Free Peoples player may discard the top 6 cards of his or her draw deck to prevent this.
lore: ...yet another weapon, swifter than hunger, the Lord of the Dark Tower had....

effect.text: Would you like to discard the top 6 cards of your draw deck to prevent discarding {chosenCard}?

title: Emboldened Orc
gametext:
Lurker. (Skirmishes involving lurker minions must be resolved after any others.)
This minion is strength +1 for each companion who is not assigned to a skirmish.
lore: Orcs are seldom intimidated, and often goaded, by superior forces.

title: Entrapping Orc
gametext: Assignment: Assign this minion to an unbound companion who has resistance 4 or less.
lore: Orcs relish the kill more than the fight itself, and will often rush to engage a weakened foe.

title: Foraging Orc
gametext: When you play this minion, you may spot another [orc] minion and a companion who has resistance 3 or less to add (2).
lore: Though most Orcs are small in stature, seldom can one be found without another nearby.

title: Frenzied Orc
gametext:
While this minion is at an underground site, each character skirmishing it is strength -2.
While you can spot 6 companions, each character skirmishing an [orc] minion is strength -2.
lore: More enemies seem only to further fuel their rage.

title: Goblin Hordes
gametext:
To play, spot an [orc] minion.
Each time the fellowship moves from an underground site, you may take an [orc] minion from your discard pile into hand.
lore: ...he saw swarming black figures: there seemed to be hundreds of orcs.

title: Hill Orc
gametext: Each time this minion wins a skirmish, you may exert each companion who has resistance 4 or less.
lore: The foul Orcs who slaughtered the last of Balin's followers still thrive in the halls of Khazad-dûm and the surrounding countryside.

title: Isengard Underling
gametext: When you play this minion, you may take an [orc] event from your discard pile into hand.
lore: Saruman's workers would exploit any resource to prepare for the coming battle.

title: Marauding Orcs
gametext: When you cannot spot another [orc] minion, discard this minion from play.
lore: Orcs that would only seek out violence at random on their own were brought together to serve Sauron's purpose.

title: Mocking Goblin
gametext: Each time this minion wins a skirmish, add a burden unless the Free Peoples player discards a Free Peoples event from hand.
lore: There was a rush of hoarse laughter, like the fall of sliding stones into a pit....

effect.text: Would you like to discard Free Peoples event from hand to prevent adding burden?

title: Mordor Scimitar
gametext:
Bearer must be an [orc] minion.
Each time bearer is assigned to skirmish a companion, you may exert that companion.
lore: Though Orcs will employ a wide variety of weaponry, they tend to favor long, curved blades.

title: Mountain Orc
gametext: Each time this minion is assigned to skirmish a companion who has resistance 5 or less, exert that companion.
lore: Larger Orcs are strong enough to run for many miles, and can tire out their prey before attacking.

title: Orc Hammer
gametext:
Bearer must be an [orc] Orc.
When you play this possession, you may exert a companion.
lore: The strongest members of an Orc tribe often wield hammers rather than blades.

title: Orc Miscreant
gametext:
To play, spot an [orc] minion.
Regroup: Exert this minion to add a burden.
lore: 'Some of the trees they just cut down and leave to rot – orc-mischief that....'

title: Orkish Smith
gametext: When you play this minion, you may take an [orc] condition from your discard pile into hand.
lore: 'There is always a smoke rising from Isengard these days.'

title: Orkish Worker
gametext: When you play this minion, you may spot another [orc] minion to reveal the top card of the Free Peoples player's deck. If it is a Shadow card, add (X), where X is its twilight cost.
lore: Saruman's Orcs labor day and night to provide him with the resources he needs to wage war.

title: Persistent Orc
gametext: Each time this minion is about to be killed or discarded from play, you may spot another [orc] card to place this minion on top of your draw deck instead.
lore: An enemy can do little worse to an Orc than what it would willingly have done to itself.

title: Porter Troll
gametext:
Damage +1. Fierce. To play, spot an [orc] minion.
When you play this minion, add a burden unless the Free Peoples player reveals a Free Peoples event from his or her hand.
lore: The mammoth battering ram Grond required equally mammoth strength to wield it.

effect.text: Would you like to reveal Free Peoples event from hand to prevent adding burden?

title: Prowling Orc
gametext:
Lurker. (Skirmishes involving lurker minions must be resolved after any others.)
Skirmish: Remove (2) to make an [orc] minion strength +1.
lore: Orcs use numbers to fell a powerful foe, though it would be generous to think of it as working together.

title: Scurrying Goblin
gametext: When you play this minion at an underground site, you may spot another [orc] minion to add (2).
lore: But it was not an echo, for when they halted it pattered on for a little all by itself, and then grew still.

title: Skulking Goblin
gametext: The fellowship's current site gains underground.
lore: 'It is a mark of evil things that came in the Great Darkness that they cannot abide the Sun....'

title: Spurred to Battle
gametext:
To play, exert an [orc] minion.
At the start of the Shadow phase, add (1).
lore: Even victory does not long slake the Orkish thirst for blood. It merely drives them onward to a new confrontation.

title: Strength in Shadows
gametext: Make an [orc] minion strength +2 (or +4 if it is a lurker).
lore: Weakened by the Sun, Orcs thrive in darkness and shadow.

title: Undisciplined
gametext:
Toil 3. (For each [orc] character you exert when playing this, its twilight cost is -3.)
Assign an [orc] minion to a companion (except the Ring-bearer).
lore: Easily caught by the heat of battle, Orc soldiers often break formation and attack where their bloodlust takes them.

title: Unyielding Goblin
gametext: Skirmish: If this minion is at an underground site, exert it to exert a companion it is skirmishing.
lore: In the rush of battle, some Orcs can carry on heedless of their own wounds until their enemy is vanquished.

title: Watchful Orc
gametext: When you play this minion, you may spot another [orc] minion to replace the fellowship's current site with an underground site from your adventure deck.
lore: Some Orcs have learned basic tracking skills.

title: Border Patrol
gametext:
When you play this condition, spot a mounted [rohan] Man to add 3 [rohan] tokens here.
Response: If a minion is played at a plains site, discard this condition or remove a [rohan] token from here to exert that minion.
lore: 'Who are you, and what are you doing in this land?'

title: Éomer
gametext:
While you can spot a [rohan] Man, Éomer's twilight cost is -1.
Each time the fellowship moves, you may exert Éomer to return a minion to its owner's hand.
lore: '...wanderers in the Riddermark would be wise to be less haughty in these days of doubt.'
subtitle: Guardian of the Eastmark

title: Éowyn
gametext: Each time Éowyn wins a skirmish, each other [rohan] Man is strength +1 until the regroup phase.
lore: 'The women of this country learned long ago: those without swords can still die upon them.'
subtitle: Shieldmaiden of Rohan

title: Gamling
gametext: At the start of the fellowship phase, you may add (1) to play a possession on Gamling from your draw deck.
lore: 'If they come to bargain for our goods at Helm's Gate, they will pay a high price....'
subtitle: Defender of the Hornburg

title: Hrothlac
gametext: Response: If a [rohan] companion who has resistance 4 or more is about to take a wound, exert Hrothlac to prevent that.
lore: '...we desire only to be free, and to live as we have lived, keeping our own, and serving no foreign lord, good or evil.'
subtitle: Man of Rohan

title: Protecting the Hall
gametext:
Toil 2. (For each [rohan] character you exert when playing this, its twilight cost is -2.)
Bearer must be a [rohan] Man.
Assignment: Discard this condition from play to make bearer defender +1.
lore: 'None are welcome here in days of war but our own folk....'

title: Rally Cry
gametext: Make a [rohan] Man who has resistance 4 or more strength +2 for each wound on each minion he or she is skirmishing.
lore: '...a sword-day, a red day, ere the sun rises!'

title: Riddermark Javelin
gametext:
Bearer must be a [rohan] Man.
Archery: Discard this possession to make the fellowship archery total +1 (or +2 if the fellowship is at a plains site).
lore: Short-hafted throwing spears are wielded by the Riders of Rohan in addition to their long lances.

title: Riddermark Soldier
gametext: When you play this companion, each [rohan] companion is strength +2 until the regroup phase.
lore: ...their faces were stern and keen.

title: Rider's Spear
gametext:
Bearer must be a [rohan] Man.
If bearer is mounted, bearer is damage +1.
lore: Shafts of the sun flared above the eastern hills and glimmered on their spears.

title: Riders of the Mark
gametext:
To play, spot 2 [rohan] companions.
You may play Riders of the Mark any time you could play a skirmish event.
When you play Riders of the Mark, you may exhaust a minion.
lore: With astonishing speed and skill they checked their steeds, wheeled, and came charging round.

title: Riding Like the Wind
gametext:
To play, exert a [rohan] Man.
While you can spot 2 [rohan] mounts, the move limit is +1.
Each of your companions that is not mounted is strength -1.
lore: The horsemen, following the trail, had turned from the river and were drawing near the downs.

title: Rohirrim Mount
gametext:
Bearer must be a [rohan] Man.
At the start of each skirmish involving bearer, each minion skirmishing bearer must exert.
While bearer is at a plains site, he or she is defender +1.
lore: The Eorlingas raise horses both peerless and cherished.

title: Rush of Steeds
gametext:
To play, spot a [rohan] Man.
Each time a Shadow condition is played, you may exert a minion.
Response: If a minion exerts as a cost of its special ability, discard this condition to prevent that and return that minion to its owner's hand.

title: Sword Rack
gametext:
Response: If a [rohan] possession is discarded from play and no more than one possession is stacked here, stack it here.
Fellowship: Add (1) to play a possession stacked here as if from hand.
lore: In Rohan, equal craft is brought to the exhibition of a blade as to the forging.

title: Théoden
gametext:
While you can spot a [gandalf] companion, Théoden gains muster. (At the start of the regroup phase, you may discard a card from hand to draw a card.)
While Théoden is at a battleground or plains site each [rohan] Man is strength +1.
lore: 'Let all my folk get ready!'
subtitle: King of the Eorlingas

title: War Now Calls Us
gametext: Exert a [rohan] companion to make him or her strength +3 (and damage +1 if he or she has resistance 5 or more).
lore: 'Mourn not overmuch! Mighty was the fallen, / meet was his ending. When his mound is raised, / women then shall weep.'

title: Concerning Hobbits
gametext: For each dwelling and forest site on the adventure path, make a Hobbit strength +1.
lore: ...they love peace and quiet and good tilled earth; a well-ordered and well-farmed countryside was their favorite haunt.

title: Crouched Down
gametext:
Stealth.
Cancel a skirmish involving a Hobbit and a minion whose strength is lower than that Hobbit's resistance.
lore: Frodo felt a sudden chill running through him and clutching at his heart....

title: Farmer Maggot
gametext: While Farmer Maggot is at a dwelling or forest site, he is strength +4.
lore: 'I didn't like the looks of him; and when Grip came out, he took one sniff and let out a yelp as if he had been stung....'
subtitle: Hobbit of the Marish

title: Frodo
gametext:
Ring-bearer. Ring-bound.
At the start of the regroup phase, you may exert Frodo to make him gain muster until the end of the regroup phase. (At the start of the regroup phase, you may discard a card from hand to draw a card.)
lore: 'I will take the Ring... though I do not know the way.'
subtitle: Protected by Many

title: Habits of Home
gametext:
Toil 2. (For each [shire] character you exert when playing this, its twilight cost is -2.)
Bearer must be a Hobbit. Limit 1 per bearer.
Each time the fellowship moves from a dwelling or forest site, remove (1).
lore: 'What about second breakfast?'

title: Hobbit Sword
gametext: Bearer must be a Hobbit.
lore: 'Strap these on....'

title: Incognito
gametext:
Stealth.
If the fellowship is at a dwelling site, exert 2 Hobbits to cancel a skirmish involving a Hobbit.
At any other site, exert 2 Hobbits to make a Hobbit strength +3.
lore: 'I am Mr. Underhill, if any name must be given.'

title: Merry
gametext: For each other unbound companion assigned to a skirmish, Merry is strength +2.
lore: 'We can't leave Frodo! Pippin and I always intended to go wherever he went, and we still do.'
subtitle: Loyal Companion

title: The More, The Merrier
gametext:
Toil 2. (For each [shire] character you exert when playing this, its twilight cost is -2.)
Spot 2 [shire] companions to remove 2 burdens.
lore: 'This, my friend, is a pint!'

title: Pippin
gametext: Skirmish: If Pippin is not assigned to a skirmish, spot an unbound companion who has less resistance than Pippin to have Pippin replace him or her in a skirmish.
lore: Merry and he had drawn their swords, but the Orcs did not wish to fight....
subtitle: Brave Decoy

title: Salt from the Shire
gametext:
Bearer must be a Hobbit.
Fellowship: Discard this possession to remove a burden.
Skirmish: If bearer is an unbound Hobbit, discard this possession to prevent him or her from being overwhelmed unless his or her strength is tripled.

title: Sam
gametext:
Ring-bound.
Each other companion is resistance +1.
lore: 'I'm coming too, or neither of us is going. I'll knock holes in all the boats first.'
subtitle: Steadfast Friend

title: Sting
gametext:
Bearer must be Bilbo, Frodo, or Sam.
Maneuver: If bearer is Bilbo or Frodo, exert him to make another companion resistance +2 until the regroup phase. If bearer is Sam, each time he wins a skirmish, you may remove a burden.
lore: This blade has dealt many wounds, by many hands.
subtitle: Weapon of Heritage

title: Sworn Companion
gametext: Make a Hobbit strength +1 for each companion who has resistance 7 or more.
lore: 'It's just something Gandalf said. ... "Don't you lose him, Samwise Gamgee." And I don't mean to.'

title: A Task Now to Be Done
gametext: Spot X Hobbits to make an unbound Hobbit resistance +X.
lore: Another opportunity for one of the shire-folk to prove their great worth. You must not fail me.

title: Unharmed
gametext: Heal a Hobbit for each minion you spot.
lore: 'So far so good; but how are we to avoid being spitted?'

title: Army of Uruk-hai
gametext:
Damage +1.
Each Free Peoples archer who has resistance 5 or less does not add to the Free Peoples archery total.
lore: Volleys of arrows are no defense against the onslaught of Saruman's servants.

title: Bloodthirsty Uruk
gametext:
Damage +1.
While you can spot an exhausted companion, this minion is strength +3.
lore: Bred for endurance, the Uruk-hai pursue their foes tirelessly.

title: Brawling Uruk
gametext:
Damage +1.
Response: If a special ability of a companion who has resistance 5 or less is used, exert this minion to cancel its effect.
lore: They are trained to parry the swords of their enemies.

title: Brutality
gametext: Make an [uruk-hai] minion strength +1 for each battleground site you can spot.
lore: Uruks are drawn to the sounds of battle.

title: Determined Uruk
gametext:
To play, spot an [uruk-hai] minion.
Each time a companion exerts, you may draw a card.
lore: As their prey grows tired, the Uruks gain the advantage.

title: Devastation
gametext: If your [uruk-hai] minion wins a skirmish, discard a condition from play.
lore: The villages hold nothing of value to the Uruk-hai; they are simply things to be destroyed.

title: Feral Uruk
gametext: While this minion is at a battleground site, it is strength +1 and damage +1.
lore: Only in combat is an Uruk-hai truly fulfilling its purpose.

title: Force of Uruk-hai
gametext:
Damage +1.
Each time this minion is about to take a wound at a battleground site, you may spot another [uruk-hai] card to make the Free Peoples player draw a card instead.
lore: Despite their bloodthirsty nature, Saruman's creations form armies and fight united for him.

title: Fortitude
gametext:
When you play this condition, spot an [uruk-hai] minion to add 3 [uruk-hai] tokens here.
Response: If an [uruk-hai] minion is about to take a wound, discard this condition or remove an [uruk-hai] token from here to prevent that.
lore: Resiliency is bred into the fighting Uruk-hai.

title: Furious Uruk
gametext:
Damage +1.
While this minion is assigned to a skirmish, each companion and Free Peoples possession loses its special abilities.
lore: The Uruk-hai attack with such ferocity that their victims find no way to strike back.

title: Furor
gametext: Make an [uruk-hai] minion strength +2 (or +3 if you can spot an exhausted companion).
lore: Uruk soldiers have learned to save their rage for the field of battle.

title: Hounding Uruk
gametext:
Damage +1.
While you can spot an exhausted companion, this minion is strength +3.
lore: An enemy on the move is an enemy unprepared.

title: Intimidating Uruk
gametext:
Damage +1.
When you play this minion at a battleground site, spot an unbound companion to make that companion resistance -2 until the end of the turn.
lore: In battle, the Uruk-hai inspire terror in even the bravest of their enemies.

title: Invincible Uruk
gametext:
Damage +1.
While this minion is at a battleground site, it cannot take wounds.
While you can spot 6 companions, each [uruk-hai] minion cannot take wounds.
lore: Like a force of nature, the Uruks are unstoppable.

title: Isengard Siege Bow
gametext:
Bearer must be an [uruk-hai] minion.
While bearer is at a battleground site, it is an archer.
lore: Saruman's machine works also makes formidable heavy bows for the Uruk-hai.

title: Isengard Sword
gametext:
Bearer must be an [uruk-hai] minion.
Each character skirmishing bearer is strength -2.
lore: The heavy-backed Uruk blades hack through armor and flesh alike.

title: Lookout Uruk
gametext:
Damage +1.
The fellowship's current site gains battleground.
lore: Choice of terrain is important when engaging the enemy.

title: Lurtz
gametext:
Archer. Damage +1. Muster. (At the start of the regroup phase, you may discard a card from hand to draw a card.)
Lurtz is strength +3 for each exhausted companion you can spot.
lore: Saruman bred this ruthless commander, whose brutality matched his own ambition, to track the Nine Walkers.
subtitle: Minion of the White Wizard

title: Murderous Uruk
gametext: Damage +1. Muster. (At the start of the regroup phase, you may discard a card from hand to draw a card.)
lore: Like a machine of Saruman, his minions are created for one purpose – killing.

title: Our Foes Are Weak
gametext: To play, spot an [uruk-hai] minion. Bearer must be an unbound companion. Limit 1 per bearer.
lore: Saruman's Uruk-hai are instilled with his ideas of destiny and supremacy.

title: Overpowering Uruk
gametext:
Damage +1. Muster. (At the start of the regroup phase, you may discard a card from hand to draw a card.)
While this minion is skirmishing a character who has resistance 3 or less, this minion is strength +3.
lore: They make short work of the weak.

title: Patrol of Uruk-hai
gametext:
Damage +1.
While this minion is skirmishing a Free Peoples character who has resistance 5 or less, this minion cannot take wounds.
lore: Their toughness comes from both armor and hide.

title: Relentless Uruk
gametext:
Damage +1.
Each time a Free Peoples event is played during a skirmish involving this minion, this minion is strength -2 until the regroup phase.
lore: Single-minded in purpose, the Uruk-hai are not easily swayed from their intended path.

title: Ruthless Uruk
gametext: Each time this minion is assigned to skirmish a character who has resistance 3 or less, you may exert this minion to discard a possession borne by that character.
lore: Weapons mean little against the strength of Uruks.

title: Sentinel Uruk
gametext:
Damage +1. Lurker. (Skirmishes involving lurker minions must be resolved after any others.)
Response: If an [uruk-hai] minion is about to take a wound in a skirmish, exert or discard this minion to prevent that.
lore: Uruks are trained to safeguard their commanders.

title: Squad of Uruk-hai
gametext:
Damage +1.
While this minion is skirmishing a character who has resistance 4 or less, this minion is damage +1.
lore: Fighting in packs, the Uruk-hai feast on the weak.

title: Swarming Uruk
gametext:
Damage +1.
While you can spot another [uruk-hai] minion assigned to a skirmish, this minion cannot take wounds.
lore: Like pack animals, the Uruk-hai find strength in numbers.

title: Tyrannical Uruk
gametext: Damage +1. Toil 1. (For each [uruk-hai] character you exert when playing this, its twilight cost is -1.)
lore: Huge, terrifying Uruks become tribal leaders.

title: Vigilant Uruk
gametext:
Damage +1. Lurker. (Skirmishes involving lurker minions must be resolved after any others.)
This minion is strength +2 for each [uruk-hai] minion not assigned to a skirmish.
lore: Some of the Uruks watch for stragglers and make certain they don't escape alive.

title: Watchman Uruk
gametext:
Damage +1.
When you play this minion at a battleground site, you may draw a card.
lore: Advanced Uruk scouts search for enemy weaknesses.

title: Dark Powers Strengthen
gametext:
Toil 2. (For each [wraith] character you exert when playing this, its twilight cost is -2.)
Spot a Nazgûl to draw 3 cards.
lore: The Witch-king nearly seized the Ring in Frodo's moment of weakness.

title: Dark Wings
gametext: Each time your [wraith] minion wins a skirmish, you may discard this condition to discard a Free Peoples condition from play.
lore: The wicked, flying beasts of the Ringwraiths snatched warriors from the battlefield and flung them like leaves in the wind.

title: Drawn to Its Power
gametext: Each time a companion is killed in a skirmish involving a Nazgûl, add a burden.
lore: 'And also the Ring drew them.'

title: Hatred Stirred
gametext: Each time a companion loses a fierce skirmish involving a [wraith] minion, you may shuffle a [wraith] card from your discard pile into your draw deck.
lore: Suddenly the foremost Rider spurred his horse forward.

title: Keening Wail
gametext:
Toil 2. (For each [wraith] character you exert when playing this, its twilight cost is -2.)
Spot a Nazgûl to add a burden.
lore: The piercing cries of the Nazgûl paralyze their enemies with fear.

title: Lost in the Woods
gametext:
Skirmish: Transfer this condition from your support area to a companion your Nazgûl is skirmishing. Limit 1 per companion.
Each [wraith] minion skirmishing bearer is strength +1 for each forest site you can spot.

title: Moving This Way
gametext: Shadow: Spot a Nazgûl and reveal a Nazgûl from hand to place the revealed card beneath your draw deck and draw a card.
lore: 'I thought there were two or three black shapes.'

title: The Pale Blade
gametext:
Bearer must be a Nazgûl.
If bearer is The Witch-king, each time he wins a skirmish, you may exert him to add a burden.
lore: Die now and curse in vain!' And with that he lifted high his sword and flames ran down the blade.
subtitle: Sword of Flame

title: Riders in Black
gametext: Reveal your hand to make a [wraith] minion strength +1 for each [wraith] minion in your hand.
lore: 'The Nine are abroad again.'

title: A Shadow Rises
gametext:
Maneuver: Remove (5) to make this condition a fierce [wraith] minion until the start of the regroup phase that has 10 strength and 3 vitality, and cannot bear other cards. This card is still a condition.
At the start of the regroup phase, remove all tokens from here.

title: Shapes Slowly Advancing
gametext:
Regroup: Discard your Nazgûl from play to add a [wraith] token here. The Free Peoples player may return a companion to hand to prevent the placement of that token.
When you can spot 4 [wraith] tokens on this condition, the Ring-bearer is corrupted.

effect.text: Would you like to return a companion to hand to prevent adding token?

title: Surrounded by Wraiths
gametext:
To play, spot a Nazgûl.
Each time the Free Peoples player plays a companion, that companion is exhausted unless the Free Peoples player pays its twilight cost again.
lore: Encircled, with nowhere to retreat, Aragorn could only hope to drive back the Nazgûl.

effect.text: Would you like to pay twilight cost again for {playedCompanion} to prevent exhausting it?

title: Úlairë Attëa
gametext:
Fierce.
Each time Úlairë Attëa is assigned to a fierce skirmish involving a character who has resistance 4 or less, you may exert Úlairë Attëa to add a burden.
lore: 'Hissed at me, he did. It gave me quite a shudder.'
subtitle: Second of the Nine Riders

title: Úlairë Cantëa
gametext: While Úlairë Cantëa is at a forest or dwelling site, he is strength +2 and fierce.
lore: 'It's from Hobbiton that this here black rider comes, unless there's more than one.'
subtitle: Fourth of the Nine Riders

title: Úlairë Lemenya
gametext: Each character skirmishing Úlairë Lemenya who has resistance 5 or less is strength -3.
lore: Terror overcame Pippin and Merry, and they threw themselves flat on the ground.
subtitle: Fifth of the Nine Riders

title: Úlairë Nelya
gametext:
Fierce.
Shadow: Exert Úlairë Nelya to replace the fellowship's current site with a site from your adventure deck.
lore: 'There's been a strange customer asking for Mr. Baggins of Bag End, and he's only just gone.'
subtitle: Third of the Nine Riders

title: Úlairë Nertëa
gametext:
Lurker. (Skirmishes involving lurker minions must be resolved after any others.)
While Úlairë Nertëa is at a forest site, he is strength +2.
While you can spot 6 companions, each Nazgûl is strength +2.
lore: Sauron's servants interrogate with terror and torture.
subtitle: Ninth of the Nine Riders

title: Úlairë Otsëa
gametext: When you play Úlairë Otsëa, you may spot a companion who has X wounds to reveal the top X cards of your draw deck. Take each [wraith] card revealed this way into hand.
lore: The riding figure sat quite still with its head bowed, as if listening.
subtitle: Seventh of the Nine Riders

title: Úlairë Toldëa
gametext:
Fierce.
Each time Úlairë Toldëa wins a skirmish, you may play the fellowship's next site.
lore: The terrifying pursuit of the Nazgûl on their Black Steeds drives their victims headlong into the wild.
subtitle: Eighth of the Nine Riders

title: The Witch-king
gametext: Fierce. Toil 2. (For each [wraith] character you exert when playing this, its twilight cost is -2.) Muster. (At the start of the regroup phase, you may discard a card from hand to draw a card.)
lore: ...a shape, black-mantled, huge and threatening.
subtitle: Captain of the Nine Riders

title: Anduin Banks
gametext: River. The minion archery total is +2 for each companion in the fellowship over 4.

title: Anduin Confluence
gametext: River. When the fellowship moves to this site, discard each ally from play.

title: Barazinbar
gametext: Mountain. At the start of your fellowship phase, you may exert a Dwarf to play a [dwarven] possession from your draw deck.

title: Buckland Homestead
gametext: Dwelling. Shadow: Play a Nazgûl to discard a condition from play.

title: Caras Galadhon
gametext: Forest. No more than 1 minion can be assigned to each skirmish.

title: Cavern Entrance
gametext: Underground. Skirmish special abilities cannot be used.

title: Chamber of Mazarbul
gametext: Underground. The Free Peoples player may transfer Free Peoples artifacts and possessions at no twilight cost.

title: Crags of Emyn Muil
gametext: Mountain. If this site is in region 2 when the fellowship moves from it during the regroup phase, wound each companion.

title: Dammed Gate-stream
gametext: Marsh. At the start of your fellowship phase, you may play a [gollum] Free Peoples card from your draw deck.

title: East Road
gametext: Forest. Each companion is twilight cost +2.

title: Ettenmoors
gametext: Plains. Skirmish: Exert your character (except an enduring character), to make it strength +2.

title: Expanding Marshland
gametext: Marsh. Shadow: If the total number of minions and twilight tokens is 3 or fewer, play a minion at twilight cost -3.

title: Fangorn Glade
gametext: Forest. When the fellowship moves to this site, add (1) for each Free Peoples weapon.

title: Flats of Rohan
gametext: Plains. Each unbound companion skirmishing more than 1 minion is strength +3.

title: Fortress of Orthanc
gametext: Battleground. When the fellowship moves to this site, add (2) for each companion over 5.

title: Green Dragon Inn
gametext: Dwelling. At the start of your fellowship phase, you may exert 2 Hobbits to play a Hobbit from your draw deck.

title: Harrowdale
gametext: Plains. Until the regroup phase, each minion skirmishing a [rohan] companion loses fierce and cannot gain fierce.

title: Heights of Isengard
gametext: Battleground. Each time a [gandalf] companion wins a skirmish, the Free Peoples player may discard a condition from play.

title: Helm's Gate
gametext: Battleground. Each character bearing a hand weapon is strength +2.

title: Mere of Dead Faces
gametext: Marsh. Regroup: Exert your Gollum or your Sméagol to play the fellowship's next site.

title: Moria Guardroom
gametext: Underground. When your fellowship moves from this site, you may spot a Dwarf to draw 2 cards.

title: Moria Stairway
gametext: Underground. Each character bearing a hand weapon is damage +1.

title: Neekerbreekers' Bog
gametext: Marsh. When the fellowship moves to here, heal each character who has resistance 5 or more and exert each other character.

title: North Undeep
gametext: River. The minion archery total is -3.

title: Old Forest Road
gametext: Forest. At the start of your fellowship phase, you may heal 2 Elves.

title: Osgiliath Reclaimed
gametext: Battleground. When the fellowship moves from this site, the Free Peoples player may spot 3 burdens to remove a burden.

title: Pelennor Fields
gametext: Plains. Each [men] minion gains ambush (1).

title: Pelennor Flat
gametext: Plains. At the start of the maneuver phase, the Free Peoples player must add a burden or discard 3 cards from hand.

title: Pinnacle of Zirakzigil
gametext: Mountain. At the start of your fellowship phase, you may exert 3 companions to play a Wizard from your dead pile.

title: The Prancing Pony
gametext: Dwelling. At the start of your fellowship phase, you may add a burden to play a ranger from your draw deck.

title: Rohan Uplands
gametext: Plains. During the archery phase, [uruk-hai] minions cannot take wounds.

title: Slag Mounds
gametext: Battleground. Each time a companion is killed, add a burden.

title: Stables
gametext: At the start of your fellowship phase, you may exert a [rohan] Man to play a [rohan] mount from your draw deck.

title: Trollshaw Forest
gametext: Forest. Each time you play an artifact or possession on your companion, you may draw a card.

title: Valley of the Silverlode
gametext: Dwelling. River. When your fellowship moves to this site, you may heal each Hobbit companion.

title: Watch-tower of Cirith Ungol
gametext: Mountain. Maneuver: Exert your [orc] minion to discard a card at random from the Free Peoples player's hand.

title: West Gate of Moria
gametext: Underground. When the fellowship moves from this site, remove (2).

title: Westemnet Village
gametext: Dwelling. When the fellowship moves to this site, the Free Peoples player wounds a companion for each ally.

title: Window on the West
gametext: Underground. Each unwounded [gondor] Man is defender +1.

title: Woody-End
gametext: Forest. Shadow: Remove a burden to play a Nazgûl from your discard pile.
